text:
anna: Quick check — can we add a p95 TTFT line to the perf dashboard that ignores cold-starts? We keep seeing spikes during rolling restarts and it's noisy for canaries.

mike: Do we have a canonical definition for TTFT we want on dashboards? Current one is time from HTTP arrival -> first token emitted (includes queuing). If we keep that, the metric will include cold-starts. Maybe add separate warm/cold metrics.

ji-hoon: +1 on separate metrics. For perf alerts we should track both `ttft_warm_p95` and `ttft_total_p95`. Alert on regression of warm. Cold is noisy.

sarah: I can take the dashboard change. Plan: add two lines and a dropdown to toggle. Will open a PR. Need the prometheus query you want.

mike: Proposed queries: 

```
# warm (exclude first 10s after pod start)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket{uptime_seconds>10}[5m])) by (le, model, env))

# total
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, env))
```

Note: `uptime_seconds` label is added by our exporter in recent rollout. If your env doesn't have it, fallback to uptime metric join.

anna: Does the nightly bench produce the tokens/sec and p95 TTFT that we expect? I saw a weird tok/s drop last night for xlarge-rt. @ji-hoon can you check benchmark logs?

ji-hoon: I ran the nightly profile earlier. Short excerpt from bench log: 

```
model=redwood-v2, seq=2048, warmups=5, reps=20
median_tok_s=185.2, p95_tok_s=210.7
median_ttft_ms=78, p95_ttft_ms=312
cold_start_p95_ms=1400
```

Looks like cold starts are the culprit. Warm p95 is fine.

sarah: Ok good. I'll wire warm vs cold into the dashboard and add a tooltip explaining sampling (we only measure first request after pod restart as cold). Also adding a small note on how `tok/s` is calculated (tokens emitted / active inference time).

mike: One more thing — can we add the KV-cache-hit ratio panel? Some regressions hide in cache miss rate. Query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_request_total[5m]))` by model.

anna: Agree. Add that. It will help triage when p95 spikes but tok/s stable.

sarah: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/482 — includes panels: ttft_warm_p95, ttft_total_p95, tok_per_s_median/p95, kv_cache_miss_rate. Will request review from @mike and @ji-hoon.

mike: Reviewing in a bit. Quick checklist:
- ensure panels default to `model=redwood-v2` and `env=prod`
- add metric unit (ms / tokens/s)
- add dashboard test that verifies panel queries compile (CI)

ops-bot: Perf canary for redwood-v2 deployed to us-west at 2026-03-17T09:12:34Z :rocket: (canary-id=c-77b2)

anna: Thanks — once PR merges, can we run a quick regression job (small bucket) to validate p95 numbers? @ji-hoon can you schedule?

ji-hoon: Yep — I'll schedule a focused run (seq 1024, warmups 5, 100 requests) right after merge and post results here.

sarah: PR updated with docs and CI test. ping @mike for final pass. :thumbsup:

mike: On it. If all good I'll merge and kick the regression.

anna: Awesome — this should reduce noise for oncall and make alerts more actionable. Thanks team!
